title: 5b-7: module boundary hints in adapter trait
description:
## Parent

sutra/44 (5b PRD: component discovery + vocabulary)

## What to build

Extend the `LanguageAdapter` trait with `module_boundary_hints()` returning a strength enum (Strong/Moderate/Weak). Implement Strong for Rust (mod system provides real boundaries), Moderate for Dart (library/part system), Weak as default. Clustering multiplies edge weights for files sharing a language-module boundary by the hint strength, biasing clusters toward language-idiomatic component boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `module_boundary_hints()` added to LanguageAdapter with default returning Weak
- [ ] Rust adapter returns Strong
- [ ] Dart adapter returns Moderate
- [ ] Clustering applies boundary hint as edge weight multiplier for co-module files
- [ ] Existing tests still pass (backward compatible — default Weak = no behavior change)

## Blocked by

- sutra/45 (5b-1: basic component discovery)

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex review (adversarial, tasks 49/50/51):\n\n- [medium] Existing workspaces can skip boundary-hint reclustering forever — stale check uses raw edge count/file count, which doesn't change on upgrade. Boundary multipliers never applied until topology changes."

messages.author: claude
messages.text: Codex finding "stale check misses boundary-hint reclustering" is a false positive. `is_clustering_stale()` includes a `clustering_config_hash` built from sorted boundary multiplier values per language + the resolution gamma. On upgrade from pre-boundary-hints code, the stored hash (no multiplier data) differs from the new hash (includes Rust=2.0, Dart=1.5), triggering automatic reclustering. No code change needed.
